# Lightfield | Product Overview

Lightfield is a natural language CRM for high-growth founders and AI-native companies that automatically assembles customer “world models” from emails, calendars, and meetings. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
